author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Nintendo Switch Sports Resort game launches October 22, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: https://ninten.do/6003aoCZb

The latest game in the intuitive sports series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2! 

Get moving solo or with family and friends across 12 immersive sports. Aim for the target’s center in Archery, knock down pins in Bowling, duke it out in Boxing, and more! 

You can also explore the island! Use Joy-Con 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, and tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.

Plus, in online or offline play, you can challenge Island Champions in the brand-new Island Crown mode, enjoy minigames with different rules, and customize your Sportsmate or Mii character with items! 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
